integrity: The complete stated theorem is analytically proved; 75 independent exact, symbolic and numeric reproduction checks pass. Published literature overlap was examined on the available evidence, with bibliographic residual risks stated. No independent validation or certification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats iid time steps strictly inside (0,2) for kick-then-drift symplectic Euler on a single linear oscillator; it concerns mean-square expected-energy growth, not an almost-sure Lyapunov exponent. The weak-jitter expansion is pointwise in h, not uniform at h=2. Specialist continuous-time random-oscillator literature is not fully accessible.
title: Exact mean-square energy growth from independent random steps in symplectic Euler
